title: PrepNow Quiz
description: A single quiz: a titled set of multiple-choice questions with answer keys.

course.description: Course id this quiz belongs to, e.g. cad.

id.description: Unique within the quiz, e.g. q1.

type.description: single = exactly one correct answer; multi = more than one.

prompt.description: The question text. May contain Markdown.

key.description: Choice label, e.g. A, B, C, D.

correct.description: Keys of the correct choice(s). For type=single this has exactly one entry.

explanation.description: Shown after submit (on incorrect answers). May contain Markdown. Do NOT reference option letters (A/B/C/D) here: the app shuffles choices, so letters are not stable. Refer to the answer content instead.
